title: Is the Sea in Madeira Clean Enough to Swim In?
description: Mostly, yes. Most of Madeira's 60 bathing waters rated excellent in 2025, but two were poor, and stream mouths are best avoided for a day after heavy rain.
heroAlt: Swimmer in deep clear blue water looking towards the pebble shore of Fajã dos Padres
keywords: is the sea in Madeira clean enough to swim in
is it safe to swim in Funchal
